inputs.original_text: Calling the Rs 700 crore corruption allegations over the proposed Cooperative Department software project politically motivated does not answer them. Cooperative institutions belong to the public and depend on people’s trust, so any misuse of their money would harm the communities and members they serve. Transparency and independent accountability matter more than partisan deflection; those responsible must provide clear answers.
inputs.modified_text: Calling the Rs 700 crore corruption allegations over the proposed Cooperative Department software project “politically motivated” is a way to dodge scrutiny, not answer it. Cooperative institutions rely on public trust and serve their members and communities; if their money is misused, ordinary people bear the cost while those with power evade responsibility. The answer is transparency and independent accountability—not partisan deflection. Those responsible must explain what happened.
